description: Detect background layers for selected nodes in a Figma file. This action analyzes the Figma document structure and identifies potential background elements for the given target nodes. It uses: - Geometric analysis (bounding box overlap/containment) - Z-index ordering (nodes earlier in the layer stack are behind later ones) - Visual properties (fills, node types) - Naming conventions (nodes named 'background', 'bg', etc.) Returns background candidates with confidence scores (0-1) and explanations.

inputSchema.description: Request to detect background layers in a Figma file.

file_key.description: File key extracted from a Figma Design file URL. Example: 'abc123XYZ' from URL figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/My-Design. NOT supported: FigJam boards or Slides.
file_key.title: File Key

search_depth.description: How many levels up in the node hierarchy to search for backgrounds. Higher values find more distant ancestors but take longer. Default: 3.
search_depth.title: Search Depth

target_node_ids.description: List of node IDs to find background layers for. Node IDs can be found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' parameter, e.g., '1:2' or '123:456'. The action will search for potential background elements that are behind these target nodes.
target_node_ids.title: Target Node Ids

inputSchema.title: DetectBackgroundRequest

name: detect_background

fill_type.description: Type of fill if present (e.g., SOLID, GRADIENT_LINEAR, IMAGE)
fill_type.title: Fill Type

name.description: The display name of the node
name.title: Name

node_id.description: The unique identifier of the node
node_id.title: Node Id

reason.description: Explanation for why this node is considered a background
reason.title: Reason

type.description: The type of the Figma node (e.g., FRAME, RECTANGLE)
type.title: Type

backgrounds.description: Map of target node IDs to their detected background candidates, sorted by confidence score descending
backgrounds.title: Backgrounds

NodeBounds.description: Bounding box coordinates of a Figma node.

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner
x.title: X

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner
y.title: Y

NodeBounds.title: NodeBounds
